title: Dot product with a matrix difference row
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$, let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The dot product of row $i$ of $C'-AB$ with $x$ equals the $i$th coordinate of $(C'-AB)x$.
